instruction_summary: Fit the TvL engine (original + one pre-declared talent-leverage dial alpha) to each real domain's measured signature triple from study 001, reconcile the fitted luck weights with the 2018-2026 literature, confront the Section-3 funding claim with the real funding-lottery record, answer the reader, and issue next-tick predictions.

steps.command: uv venv /workspace/.venv && uv pip install numpy scipy pandas matplotlib torch pyreadr pypdf

steps.description: Wrote the alpha-dial wrapper around staged tvl.py; gate 4 bit-identity at alpha=1 (max abs diff 0.0)
Assembled per-domain target statistics + standardization SEs (001 CI / pair-bootstrap / share-bootstrap on reconstructed 001 vectors / binomial-proportion); reconstructions match 001 <1e-6
Ran the 11 alpha x 5 p_L x 100 = 5500-run calibration grid (CRN per p_L), chunked one alpha per call
Per-domain nearest-cell fit + pre-declared 3-SE joint falsification test
T2 reconciliation table (same-construct comparisons; Csurilla flagged untraceable)
T3 funding frontier: egalitarian vs elitarian efficiency across alpha (11 x 3 strategies x 200 runs), verdict vocabulary
T5 next-tick predictions (tennis persistence, chess-tennis gap, 2027 WSOP repeat-champion null)
All four validation gates (001 completed+gated; anchor reproduces tvl_reference exactly; literature traceable; alpha=1 bit-identical)
Figures: fit map, funding frontier, structural-gap summary

key_results.T1_joint_3SE_fit: FAILS for all four fitted domains (tennis, chess, movies, baseball); poker & MusicLab excluded
key_results.structural_failure_1_winner_skill: model winner skill percentile reachable only in [0.485,0.727]; real >= 0.99 (tennis 0.994, movies 0.999) -> unreachable
key_results.structural_failure_2_persistence: model y2y top-100 persistence pinned in [0.957,0.964]; real 0.49-0.87 (chess 0.87 > tennis 0.68 > baseball 0.49) -> unreachable
key_results.funding_flip_alpha: none (no flip in [0,1]); egalitarian efficiency ~9x elitarian at every alpha

comparison_to_original.followup: reachable range 0.485-0.727 over all 55 grid cells

comparison_to_original.original: 001 shipped only the model-side p_L ladder; no funding verdict (deferred to 002)
comparison_to_original.followup: egalitarian beats elitarian at every alpha in [0,1] (no flip); efficiency ~9x
comparison_to_original.note: P4 verdict: untested but consistent; real system Matthew (Bol 2018), no outcome RCT

deviations: T1 joint 3-SE fit FAILS for all four fitted domains; this is the pre-declared falsification outcome (a finding against the TvL family's sufficiency), not an execution failure.
Fitted alpha values are nearest cells of FAILED fits, not calibrated parameters.
Csurilla et al. 2023 (named in T2 spec) is absent from the staged literature/PROVENANCE.md; included direction-only with no cited number (gate-3-clean).
Poker and MusicLab excluded from the T1 fit (TvL-A5 demotion; 001 gated ELSE branch).

Grid uses common random numbers (one seed per p_L across alpha, 100 replicates/cell) for variance reduction; the anchor cell still reproduces 001 within MC CI and the dedicated bit-identical 1000-run reproduction matches exactly.
Share standardization SEs bootstrapped on success vectors reconstructed via 001's own filters (reconstructions match 001 <1e-6); P(top-decile) SEs without a 001 CI use the binomial-proportion SE.
Engine substitution (shared-data/tvl-engine not staged -> faithful replication engine) inherited from 001; alpha=1 bit-identity confirms soundness.

[003 audit-conformance 002-1a, inherited from 001-2] Truncation deviation: Spec 5 Block A G2 says 'no truncation' but 001's G2 run (and 002's inheriting grid/anchor) used truncate_talent=True for construct-consistency with the staged QA distcheck anchor bands (computed with truncation ON; clips ~3e-5 of draws, immaterial); carried through unchanged, alpha=1 bit-identical to 001 baseline.
